notes.title: 7/25/2023(JST) SOULVARS Update Notice!
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continued support of SOULVARS!
Referring your comments, we have released following updates in the patch distributed today.

■Addition of tutorial drones.
We have added tutorial drones in various locations to give you tips.

■Addition of notices when obtaining KARMA rewards.
A notification mark will now appear in MENU > DDO NaviMenu > KARMA when there is a KARMA that has not yet acquired a reward.

■Changing rules for opening tutorial items.
The rules for opening items in MENU > DDO NaviMenu > TUTORIAL have been revised so that each item can be viewed from the beginning.

■Improvement of using the space key.
The space key, which was previously only used to make selections during battles, can now be used to make decisions in other operations as well.

■Adjustment of some balance.
Balance adjustments have been made to some strong enemies and encounter rates.

■Fixed other problems including text.
The problem of text misalignment during translation has been fixed.

We hope you continue to enjoy SOULVARS, which is now easier to play!

notes.title: Important Update for SOULVARS Fans Who Purchased the Full Version Early
notes.notes:
Dear SOULVARS fans,

Thank you for your continued support!

As you may be aware, there was an accidental early release of SOULVARS on June 19th, but the issue has been resolved. Today, we are here to provide an update for users who have purchased the full version of the game.

For those who have purchased full version of SOULVARS:
We are excited to announce that a launch discount will be available starting from the official release on June 27th (JST). Since the price you paid was not discounted, we want to ensure that you have the opportunity to benefit from the reduced price as well. To do so, please follow the steps outlined below:

1. Request a refund on Steam

For assistance with the refund process, please consult the official help article provided at this link: https://help.steampowered.com/faqs/view/784C-923B-A4A1-C825
This will allow you to repurchase SOULVARS at the discounted price.

2. Repurchase SOULVARS during the launch discount period

Once the game is officially released on June 27th (JST), please visit the following sales page to repurchase SOULVARS: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2087910/SOULVARS/
By doing so, you will be able to obtain SOULVARS at the discounted price.


We sincerely appreciate your support and patience throughout this situation. We hope that you have been enjoying the SOULVARS DEMO during the Steam Nest Fest, and we look forward to providing you with an even better gaming experience with the full version.

Thank you again for being part of the SOULVARS and SHUEISHA GAMES community!

notes.title: [UPDATE] SOULVARS Release Date Updated!
notes.notes:
Dear SOULVARS fans,

Thank you for your continued support of Shueisha Games!

As we announced yesterday, the Soulbits in our hand were overflowing this weekend, and SOULVARS was accidentally released a little bit early. Our SOULS just couldn’t wait to ignite!

Thanks to some quick help from Valve, we rewound the time and set the release date back to June 27th! The launch will have a discount, so don’t miss it!

To those who have already purchased SOULVARS!  First, thanks; we love you, and your support Dominates our hearts.  We just wanted to let you know that we haven't received confirmation yet on whether asking for a refund will affect your ability to use the launch discount. If you could hold off on requesting a refund for just a little bit longer, we would be extremely grateful. Thanks again for your support!

Thanks for all your support and patience! 
We hope you enjoy SOULVARS DEMO during Steam Nest Fest!

notes.title: Apology for the early release of the full version of "SOULVARS"
notes.notes:
Dear SOULVARS fans,

Thank you for your continued support of Shueisha Games!

You may have noticed the game was released over the weekend early on Steam. This was done in error, and we are looking to rectify it so it releases properly on June 27th as planned.

Our goal is to ensure that everyone can enjoy the complete version of the game when it becomes available for sale next week. To make this a reality, we're now checking if we can stop releasing the full version, but it’s not confirmed.
In the meantime, please refrain from buying SOULVARS until the issue is resolved.

To those who purchased the full version
We apologize for the inconvenience caused. If you would like to request a refund, please wait until we can confirm with Valve:

Whether we can properly apply our launch discount. If not at launch, we will provide a discount as soon as possible.
If refunding the game now will cause problems for those who plan to buy SOULVARS at a discount in the future. 

We will make an announcement via Steam when we have updates.

Valve’s refund rules will apply, so please be sure not to play the game longer than two hours, or it may not be possible to process your request.

Thanks for all your support and patience! While we wait for the release issue to be resolved, you can still try the demo during Steam Next Fest! We hope you enjoy SOULVARS!
